summary: Satellite office desk: mismatched EU/UK adapter, missing ergonomic footrest, and 48-hour temp badge request
description:
Issue summary:
- New hire (contractor) arriving at Redwood satellite hub (London, Unit 3) needs desk fully provisioned. Outbound shipment arrived with incorrect power adapters (EU two-pin instead of UK three-pin) for monitor and docking station. Ordered ergonomic footrest (SKU FR-21) is missing from the pallet.

Impact:
- Contractor starts Monday 2026-03-15 and requires working desk and temporary building badge for 48 hours. Without UK adapters the monitor/dock won't power; missing footrest is a comfort/ergonomics risk for long sessions and must be provided prior to first day if possible.

Location:
- London satellite hub, Unit 3, Desk cluster B, row 2 (assigned desk B2-07). Courier manifest (DHL AWB 1234-5678-GB) indicates items delivered but packaging mismatch noted in intake photo.

Requested outcome:
- Confirm and ship two UK three-pin power adapters to Unit 3 by 2026-03-13 end of day.
- Locate/ship ergonomic footrest (FR-21) or provide a local loaner by 2026-03-14.
- Issue a temporary building badge active 2026-03-15 08:00–2026-03-16 18:00 for contractor (Name: Jordan Reyes) and add contractor to guest Wi-Fi allowlist.
- Coordinate IT for keyboard/mouse pairing and quick VPN onboarding at desk setup time.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Receive delivery at Unit 3 intake and cross-check packing list against manifest
2) Unbox monitor and dock, attempt power — observe UK socket incompatibility
3) Search local storage for FR-21 footrest and confirm not present
4) Attempt to provision temp badge via access-control console and hit role mapping issue for 'contractor' group
investigation_notes: Intake team photo ID 2026-03-10_15:42 shows EU-style plugs attached to monitor power brick (expected UK).
Warehouse scanning shows FR-21 marked as 'picked' but not packed — likely missed at packing station (picklist PR# 987612).
Access-control console returned error 'role_mapping_not_found' when creating temp badge for group=contractor; likely missing group mapping for satellite Unit 3 in SSO config.
DHL tracking shows delivery signed at 2026-03-10 16:03 to 'Unit 3 Receiving', but manifest mismatch flagged in intake notes.
comments: 2026-03-11 - Taylor Nguyen: Logged after intake team escalated. Contractor start date 2026-03-15; need high-priority handling.
2026-03-11 - Facilities (Riley Martinez): I can drop a pair of UK adapter pigtails from the regional kit this afternoon — will confirm stock. Will check storage for FR-21 loaners.
2026-03-11 - Logistics (Priya Singh): Opening inquiry with DHL for manifest mismatch (case DHL-78921). Also pulling pick/pack video at 2026-03-10 14:00 from warehouse cameras.
2026-03-12 - IT (Samir Patel): I can handle keyboard/mouse pairing remotely but need the temp badge active to join guest network. Access-control team, please confirm badge provisioning window.

2026-03-13 - Access-Control (Lina Gomez): Found missing role mapping for 'contractor-satellite' in SSO. I will add mapping and create a 48-hour badge for Jordan Reyes. Badge ID TEMP-REYES-330001 created; activation scheduled 2026-03-15 08:00 to 2026-03-16 18:00.

2026-03-13 - Riley Martinez: UK adapters dispatched via local courier (internal ticket SUPP-2026) — ETA Unit 3 2026-03-13 18:30. Footrest loaner FR-LNR-002 reserved for B2-07; finalizing pickup from central storage.
next_steps: Facilities to confirm adapter delivery in ticket comments once on-site (Riley)
Logistics to review pick/pack footage and update warehouse SOP if picklist mismatch confirmed (Priya)
Access-Control to confirm badge handed to security desk and provide pickup PIN for contractor (Lina)
IT to perform remote pairing and VPN check-in during contractor's first hour (Samir)
